tax.text: He supports making the tax cuts permanent and opposes raising taxes on working Americans.
tax.quote: I support making President Trump's tax cuts permanent and will fight against any effort to raise taxes on hardworking Americans.

wages.text: He backed a proposal to stop Pennsylvania from automatically collecting union dues for unions.
wages.quote: The state of Pennsylvania ought not to be in the business of collecting union dues and handing them over to union bosses to fund the Democratic party machine.

trade.text: He said farmers recognize that Trump's tariffs respond to foreign countries selling goods cheaply in the United States.
trade.quote: President Trump is the first president, in a very long time, who came in and said, this isn’t right.

schools.text: His campaign biography says he and his wife worked to promote school choice through the Herzog Foundation.
schools.quote: Chris and his wife Christine have worked actively to promote school choice through the Herzog Foundation for families struggling to find quality education in their communities.

safety.text: He says he would focus accountability for violent crime on criminals rather than responsible gun owners.
safety.quote: I will fight to defend our right to keep and bear arms while ensuring criminals, not responsible citizens, are held accountable for violent crime.

immigration.text: He supports securing the border, finishing the wall, ending catch-and-release, and deporting dangerous criminal undocumented immigrants.
immigration.quote: I support President Trump's efforts to secure the border, finish the wall, end catch-and-release policies, and deport dangerous criminal illegal immigrants.

guns.text: He opposes federal efforts to restrict gun rights and says he will defend the right to keep and bear arms.
guns.quote: I support President Trump's commitment to protecting the constitutional rights of law-abiding gun owners and will oppose efforts to restrict those rights through federal overreach.

abortion.text: He describes himself as pro-life and supports policies to defend the unborn and protect what he calls innocent life.
abortion.quote: I am proudly pro-life and believe every human life is a gift from God that deserves protection.

voting.text: He supports the SAVE Act, which he says would ensure only U.S. citizens can vote in federal elections.
voting.quote: I also support the SAVE Act to ensure only American citizens can vote in federal elections.

tax.text: Smead says Congress should invest in public needs rather than give wealthy people more tax breaks.
tax.quote: Instead of giving the wealthy more tax breaks, we need to invest in our people, our children, our schools, our roads, and our rural hospitals.

debt.text: He argues that cutting Medicare and Social Security would harm people who have paid into those programs.
debt.quote: To cut programs such as Medicaid, possibly Medicare, and Social Security is to do a horrific disservice to the tens of millions of Americans who have paid into the system our whole working lives

tax.text: Maidment says he wants to reduce taxes and argues that the federal income tax should end.
tax.quote: You work hard for your money and no one has any business saying you should have to give it up.

trade.text: He says the U.S. should pursue peaceful trade to support prosperity.
trade.quote: We can focus our efforts on maintaining a robust national defense, trading peacefully with others so we can all become more prosperous.

debt.text: Maidment called the national debt a major problem and criticized spending bills he said add to it.
debt.quote: I look at $31 trillion and I look at my son, who is a teenager, and I'm like, your kids are gonna be paying this off. And that's not fair.

guns.text: His campaign says he wants to extend the right to keep and bear arms.
guns.quote: Extend our right to keep and bear arms so we can protect ourselves and our other rights.
